claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Sulfacetamide is a bacteriostatic sulfonamide (PABA antagonist) with no meaningful antiproliferative activity against human cancer cells at 2.5 uM; the only reported mammalian interaction is weak inhibition of serum paraoxonase 1, which is not cytotoxic, so the compound is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
